name: detran
description: DETRAN suite monorepo — unified modular-monolith backend (inf/est/ch/ops + transversal portal/dashboard), frontend apps, senatran-mock and the senatran-adapter national-API boundary.
author: Antonio Augusto Russo <aarusso@nyxk.com.br>

scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm blueprints:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm --filter @detran/ui test && pnpm --filter @detran/ui build && pnpm verify:decorators && pnpm verify:rls-ddl
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @detran/shared build && pnpm --filter @detran/app build && pnpm --filter @detran/ui build
scripts.backend:test:ci: pnpm backend:test:unit && pnpm backend:test:integration && pnpm backend:test:e2e
